top_signals.title: Seven Chinese Vessels Permitted to Sail to Europe via Russian Arctic Route
top_signals.summary: Russia's state nuclear giant Rosatom, operator of the Northern Sea Route via the Arctic, said on Friday it had issued permits for seven Chinese transit vessels to sail to Europe via the NSR.Chinese container company Sea Legend Shipping plans to launch the first regular container service to Europe vi
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump Media and Crypto.com end partnerships as companies shift priorities
top_signals.summary: This ends plans Trump Media, Crypto.com and Yorkville Acquisition Corp. had to turn Yorkville into a CRO treasury company.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Majority Leader Thune files cloture on Clarity Act, setting up Sept. 15 Senate vote
top_signals.summary: The Senate is set to vote on the motion on Tuesday, Sept. 15, the day after the body returns, though at least seven non-Republicans will need to support it.
